**Finding: Compliant — no redline proposed.**

The Agreement contains no liquidated damages or penalty payable by Clear Capital:

- **§ 3 (Compensation)** — time-and-materials fees, out-of-pocket expenses, and taxes only; no late-payment penalty or interest charge.
- **§ 6 (Termination)** — either party may terminate on fifteen (15) days' notice (for convenience where no SOW is outstanding, or for uncured material breach). On termination, Contractor is paid only "all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned … through the effective date of such termination" — no early-termination fee, minimum commitment, or stipulated damages. § 7(c) (a stray subsection) repeats the same wind-down formula for both § 6(a) and § 6(b) terminations.
- **§ 7 (Limitations of Liability)** — caps Clear Capital's liability at fees paid to Contractor and waives consequential/lost-profit damages mutually.

Targeted searches for "liquidated damages", "penalt", "interest", and "Company shall pay" surfaced nothing that operates as a Customer-payable liquidated amount. The preferred playbook position is already met, so no edit is warranted.

Two adjacent points worth noting for the broader review (outside this rule): § 7 is captioned "INDEMNIFICATION OF CONTRACTOR" but contains no indemnity text, and § 3(b) lets Contractor change rates on 30 days' notice — both belong to other playbook rules rather than the LD analysis.
